name: Can I live in my home during post-remodel painting?
description: Living in your home during painting is possible but involves fumes and limited access; discuss schedules and low-VOC options with your contractor.

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during post-remodel painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible to live in your home during post-remodel painting, it requires careful coordination and can impact your comfort due to paint fumes and limited access to certain areas. Painters at Frasheski Construction typically use low-VOC paints where possible to minimize odors, but some disruption is unavoidable. Discussing the painting schedule and potential for temporary relocation for specific phases, such as whole-interior painting, will help manage expectations and minimize inconvenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during painting is possible but involves fumes and limited access; discuss schedules and low-VOC options with your contractor.
